The Anatomy of a Jacket

Scroll — and watch a jacket come together

Scroll down ↓

  1. 01The Shell

    The main body, cut from premium fabric — every jacket's structure starts here.

  2. 02The Sleeves

    Set-in sleeves that sit naturally on the shoulder. Never tight, never loose.

  3. 03The Lapels

    Sharp notch lapels — the most recognised, most classic part of the jacket.

  4. 04The Collar

    A hand-finished collar that stays clean, straight and smart on the neck.

  5. 05Buttons & Pockets

    Gold-finish buttons, a chest welt pocket and flap pockets. Small details, big difference.

  6. 06The Finish

    Fine stitching along every seam — the finishing that turns a jacket into luxury.

Fabric & Craft

Built slowly, worn daily

Four things we refuse to compromise on — in every T-shirt and every jacket that carries the MK name.

Material

Heavyweight breathable cotton for tees; premium leather-finish shells with warm quilted lining for jackets. Fabric you can feel the quality of.

Stitching

Reinforced seams and fine, even stitching on every join — checked piece by piece before a jacket is allowed to leave.

Fit

A modern, honest fit across S to XL — structured on the shoulder, easy through the body. Between sizes? Take the larger one for jackets.

Care

Tees: cold wash, dry in shade. Leather: wipe with a soft dry cloth, keep away from direct heat. Cared for well, they age beautifully.

Before you order

Measure your chest and match it to the size guide below. T-shirts run true to size; for jackets, if you are between sizes or plan to layer a sweater underneath, choose the larger size.

Delivery is completely free, everywhere in Pakistan. Add your items to the cart and tap Order on WhatsApp — your order opens ready to send. Or message us at 03336826856 — we confirm your order and delivery time personally.

Cash on Delivery. You pay only when your parcel arrives at your door. Use code KHAYYAM10 at cart for 10% off your order total.

Message us on WhatsApp within 7 days of delivery, keep the piece unused with its tags, and we will exchange it for the right size.

Wipe with a soft, dry cloth. Never machine-wash leather, and store it on a wide hanger away from direct heat and sunlight so the finish stays rich.
